name: cricket07_online
description: Online multiplayer port of EA Sports Cricket 07 in the browser using static recompilation, WebAssembly, and WebGPU

scripts.build:dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/build', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','loader.js','netplay.js','audio-worklet.js','coi-serviceworker.min.js','_headers'].forEach(f=>{ if(fs.existsSync('web/'+f)) fs.copyFileSync('web/'+f, 'dist/'+f); }); if(fs.existsSync('web/build')) { fs.cpSync('web/build', 'dist/build', {recursive:true}); } else if(fs.existsSync('build_web/www')) { fs.cpSync('build_web/www', 'dist/build', {recursive:true}); } console.log('Built dist/ bundle successfully');"

author: HRDevelops
